title: MUT Create Power|更多锻造模板：齿轮力量
description: This is a linkage Module for create and mut.
body:
This is a linkage module for Create and More Upgrade Template.
It introduces multiple tiers of diving suits and backtanks — from Iron to Steel, Netherite-Copper, and Advanced Steel — each with unique armor values, air capacity bonuses, and fire resistance. The mod also adds customizable water wheels made from various materials like Obsidian, Debris Log, Gilding, and Blue Diamond, each supporting fluid-based speed and stress multipliers through a configurable fluid bonus system. Fully compatible with Create's kinetic and diving systems, including goggle overlays, pressurized air, and lava swimming. Designed for players who want more progression, variety, and engineering depth in their Create-powered world.
